name: 27863 · Pikeville, NC
findings: ZIP 27863 (Pikeville) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27863 (Pikeville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27863 (Pikeville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
